title: Professional Certificate in Understanding the Role of Human Resource Management
description: The Professional Certificate in Understanding the Role of Human Resource Management is designed to prepare the learner to take on the strategic role of human resources in any organization.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate in Understanding the Role of Human Resource Management is designed to prepare the learner to take on the strategic role of human resources in any organization. This course will highlight the important role human resources play in the achievement of strategic organizational goals while strategizing to achieve this role effectively.
